website-building.name: Website building
features: Pages for each service or product (each one counts)
A contact page with a form

ui-ux-design.name: UI/UX design
features: A map of how people move through it
Rough layouts of the main screens
A shared set of design rules
A prototype you can click through
A handover pack for the developers
Redoing a flow you already have

business-model.name: Business model design
features: A map of what you're assuming
A review once you've tested it

documentation.name: Documentation
features: Guides for the people using it
A guide for your own team
A fresh rewrite of your docs

marketing-content.name: Marketing and content
features: A content plan, month by month
A list of technical SEO fixes

integrations: A way to edit the site yourself
types: Adding to something you already have
security: We're interested in a penetration test

inputs.website-building: The words and photos for the site, your logo and brand look, access to your domain and hosting, and one person who can approve things.
inputs.ui-ux-design: Access to what you have now, any user info you've gathered, and people willing to try it out.
inputs.business-model: Whatever sales and cost numbers you have, time with the founders to talk, and help running the tests.
inputs.documentation: Access to the system and code, time with the key people, and one technical person to check it.
inputs.penetration-testing: A test setup, or your written OK to test the live one, test accounts for each role, one technical contact, and the three signed documents.
inputs.marketing-content: Access to the product and the people who know it best, quick sign-off on drafts, and analytics access if you have it.

strings.empty: Nothing picked yet. Choose a service and we'll build your brief from there.

strings.noRisk: Nothing in your answers raises a flag for us.

strings.disclaimer: This brief is a starting point. It isn't a quote, and it doesn't promise a delivery date.
strings.otherInWords: other things, in your own words
strings.fixedScope: No size band here: for penetration testing we only quote once we've talked and agreed exactly what's covered. One retest of what we report is included.

strings.riskContent: Your content isn't ready, and that's the delay we see most often. Give it a date, or let us add the writing to the work.

strings.riskDate: You've got a fixed date ({date}). If everything you want can't fit before it, we'll tell you honestly what could wait until after launch.
strings.riskIntegrations: Three or more outside services to connect. Each one has its own rules and its own setup time.
strings.riskPentest: Penetration testing needs its own written plan, plus your signed permission and an NDA, before we test anything.
strings.riskSecurity: It's not clear yet what you need on security. Our free self-check is a good place to start.

strings.legendTimeline: When does it need to be done?
